ideas.pitch: An enterprise AI agent that automatically audits Indian health insurance claim rejections against IRDAI guidelines and hospital policy PDFs to draft legally sound appeal letters.
ideas.title: ClaimShield AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Healthcare domain with high-impact economic benefit, mirroring the enterprise agent architecture that wins major hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered AML and risk detection platform tailored for Indian FinTechs, combining graph intelligence to flag suspicious multi-hop UPI layering transactions.
ideas.title: GraphKYC India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles FinTech regulatory pain points with a graph-based ML backend, following the exact blueprint of recent 1st-place hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: A Web3 supply chain traceability platform that issues verifiable tokenized receipts for organic farmers in India, ensuring fair MSP transactions via smart contracts.
ideas.title: CropLedger Blockchain
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines Agriculture and Web3 & Blockchain domains into a concrete economic benefit application with real-world applicability in India.

ideas.pitch: An IoT and satellite data-driven dashboard that calculates hyper-local carbon offsets for Indian manufacturing MSMEs to help them comply with green standards.
ideas.title: AuraPulse Carbon
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on Environment & Sustainable Development with quantifiable metrics, making it easy for judges to evaluate environmental impact.

ideas.pitch: A vernacular EduTech AI companion that generates hyper-localized regional case studies and interactive quizzes for rural Indian school curricula.
ideas.title: Sarthi AI Tutor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the EduTech domain with clear, measurable accessibility impact for underserved students in India.
